in_marathi.name: Dharikansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharikansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharikansh is derived from the Sanskrit words Dharma and Kansh. Dharma represents righteousness, duty, and law. Kansh signifies compassion, love, and kindness. The name Dharikansh symbolizes a person who embodies righteousness and compassion, someone who upholds dharma in his actions while also showing compassion and kindness towards others.
